versions.content: EcuM2483: The driver has to notify ECU State Manager by invoking the EcuM_SetWakeupEvent service once when a wakeup event is detected. The same service should also be invoked during initialization of the driver if a pending wakeup event is detected during the initialization. Preferably, the invocation is done from a callout or function stub of the caller, to decouple driver modules and ECU State Manager.
